message: No detected input validation: The code reads properties directly from the database and converts them without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards.
No detected untrusted source handling: The dataset is loaded from a local file path with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: The code loads and appends label values directly without any distribution checks, range validation, or label-noise detection tools like Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to the dataset before or after preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: Although the code imports model_from_json and load_model from Keras, there is no evidence in the visible code of hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions when loading any serialized model.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads and processes labels (TPROP, AE, EGAP, etc.) without any checks for class balance, expected label ranges, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard Keras/SGD/Adam optimizers with no differential privacy wrappers such as Opacus or TensorFlow Privacy.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a random permutation is used to split data, there is no explicit isolation of a held-out test set from training, no signed/hashed evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code directly reads and uses dataset properties and representations without any input shape/range checks, schema validation, or rejection of malformed inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs for NaN values, out-of-range predictions, or sanity bounds before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a numerical/molecular property prediction pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
